questions.question: A fully managed platform that provides every developer and data scientist with the tools to build, train, tune, and deploy machine learning models quickly at scale without managing infrastructure.

A natural language processing (NLP) service that uses machine learning to find insights and relationships in text, including sentiment analysis, key phrase extraction, entity recognition, and topic modeling.
A fully managed ML service that uses statistical and machine learning algorithms to deliver highly accurate time-series forecasts without requiring prior ML experience.
A computer vision service that makes it easy to add image and video analysis to your applications, detecting objects, scenes, activities, text, faces, and celebrities.
A document analysis service that automatically extracts text, handwriting, and structured data such as forms and tables from scanned documents, going beyond simple OCR.
An automatic speech recognition (ASR) service that makes it easy to add speech-to-text capability to your applications, supporting multiple languages and custom vocabulary.
A service for building conversational interfaces into any application using voice and text. It uses the same deep learning technologies that power Alexa to recognize intent and manage dialogue.
A text-to-speech service that turns text into lifelike speech, allowing you to create applications that talk and build speech-enabled products in dozens of languages and voices.
A neural machine translation service that delivers fast, high-quality, and affordable language translation between supported languages, enabling localization of content for diverse global users.
